about_the_game:
Based on the cash you actually have in real life,
For example, ten thousand.
Enter it into the game and gamble.

Based on your actual thoughts about gambling in real life,
For example, winning one million.
Transfer that goal into the game and achieve it.

Start over after each failure.
Start over after each success.


Through this process,
I hope you will believe that
Gambling is impossible to win.

Even under absolutely ideal circumstances.
No matter how you bet,
As long as there's a service fee involved,
you will ultimately lose.

And the casino's primary profit isn't the service fee.
Because the casino calculates this all-important service fee incorrectly.
When I happened to calculate the service fee for both parties separately,
I discovered that this is the correct way to calculate the service fee. Without a doubt.


This is the best version I've written in years.
I hope you buy it.
Love it.
Thank you for stopping by.
(
Always the original price. No discounts. No price reductions. No price increases. Never change.
)
